mission: Independently audit the first identical-worker canary wave from durable evidence only. Reconstruct claims, STARTED runs, returns, DONE/boundary states, collision behavior, duplicate-work risk, missing lineage, post-return continuation and actual useful outputs; grade mechanisms against Verification + Critic Control and challenge the parent verification snapshot.
acceptance_criteria: remediation opportunities are concrete and falsifiable
result_summary: All seven Wave-1 opportunities have durable claims/runs/returns and terminal DONE runs with substantive candidate outputs. Parent verification is materially supported but overstates three mechanisms: collision loss/retry has only self-reported loser evidence; BIG13->POSTRETURN lacks durable same-session lineage because worker_instance_id changes and no previous_run/session field links it; write-scope isolation is contract evidence without per-run changed-path receipts. WBOOT->PROPOSALS is fully lineaged. Promotion remains KEEP_WC_CANARY / DO_NOT_PROMOTE_GENERIC_W_FROM_WAVE1.
write_scope: claim + own run + own return only

Parent snapshot counts two bounded post-return second claims, but only WBOOT->PROPOSALS has stable durable worker lineage; BIG13->POSTRETURN is textually asserted but identity-unlinked.
Parent snapshot grades claim collision retry PASS_CANARY although durable evidence of the loser attempts is worker self-report rather than independent host receipts.
Parent snapshot grades write-scope isolation PASS_CANARY although run contracts lack independent per-run commit/write-set attestations.
